# FMC Media PC 0.3.20

- EgyDead is now a built-in Direct provider, with its servers and quality choices in the Direct source browser. Title, year and movie/series identity are checked before listing a work. Playback refreshes the selected host and quality instead of reusing an expiring video URL.
- The catalog uses the existing app-local secure DNS transport. Mixdrop plays through the local media relay with range seeking; StreamHG additionally removes its PNG segment prefix. No system DNS change, account, Python installation or Debrid key is required.

Validation: 90 Python source tests, 62 frontend tests and all three native P2P tests passed. The packaged source engine found 11 links for The Odyssey (2026); mpv decoded Vidara at 1920×1080, Mixdrop at 1280×720 and StreamHG at 1280×720. The P2P check transferred an 8-second generated video between real local peers using a Magnet URL, selected the requested file and decoded both the beginning and a seek with mpv.

Quality choices follow the provider's labels; the player reports the actual video dimensions. Byse, Doodstream and VOE are omitted because their playback could not be validated. Website origins can rotate and individual hosts can become unavailable. Full-length playback and physical HDR output were not tested in this release.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Windows x64. Existing activation, settings, library and watch progress are preserved.
